confirmatory_reexecution.interpretation: The executable model and notebook code were unchanged; the later revision added only registration documentation and tests. JSON hashes changed because code_revision provenance changed, while every reported numerical effect was reproduced exactly.

interpretation.formal_primary_outcome: Replacing teacher mechanism STATE with recursively predicted STATE increases eight-ms normalized STATE RMSE by 481% at the median, with the same direction in all three seeds. This cleanly identifies exposure to predicted mechanism state as a major temporal-composition limit.
interpretation.voltage_safety_amendment: The preregistered primary-outcome logic measured voltage feedback only through downstream STATE RMSE. Under that metric predicted voltage appears beneficial because it reduces STATE error by about 10%. Direct voltage metrics show the opposite: eight-ms voltage RMSE is about 26 mV, 46% worse than persistence in every seed, with 314 physical-range violations. A multivariate physical system cannot accept this compensatory error, so voltage feedback is retained as a co-primary repair target.
interpretation.causal_specificity: The authentic joint model retains a 7.11 percentage-point median STATE advantage over the shuffled-training control under full feedback. The causal coupling signal survives the harder contract and should be preserved during repair.
interpretation.ion_context: Holding the initial ion context adds only 0.98% median STATE error, below the 2% main-effect gate. A dedicated ion updater is not the first repair priority at the tested eight-ms horizon.
interpretation.optimization_schedule: The constant-over-cosine full-feedback difference is only 0.64 percentage points at the median and reverses strongly in seed 61017. The exploratory constant-schedule signal from 06b-d is not confirmed.
interpretation.interaction: Predicted voltage partially compensates mechanism-STATE error while simultaneously destroying voltage accuracy. The large negative voltage-by-STATE interaction is therefore evidence of objective misalignment, not a healthy recurrent solution.
interpretation.scientific_conclusion: The next repair must jointly address exposure to predicted mechanism STATE and stable voltage recurrence under direct voltage constraints. Optimizing STATE alone would reward an unphysical compensatory path.
interpretation.amendment_status: The mechanism-STATE diagnosis is the preregistered primary result. Treating direct voltage failure as a co-primary blocker is a transparent post-execution systems-safety amendment based on metrics and physical bounds already recorded by the experiment; it is not relabelled as a preregistered success.

next_step: preregister one synchronized train-only matrix crossing mechanism-STATE exposure repair with direct stable-voltage recurrence constraints and a shuffled causal control
